name: turnstile
title: Cloudflare Turnstile
description: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection: server-side token verification helper and a themed widget component.
docs: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection. Create a widget at dash.cloudflare.com, then set `NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` (client) and `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` (server). Render `<Turnstile />` in a form and call `verifyTurnstileToken()` in the server action. The feature turns on automatically when both keys are set.
